figurative_meaning_en: Unjust law; law against public interest
example_sentences_in_bangla: সরকারের এই কালা-কানুন সকলের জীবন কঠিন করে তুলেছে।
ঐতিহাসিকভাবে অনেক কালা-কানুন জনগণের অধিকার কেড়ে নিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This black law from the government has made everyone's life difficult.
Historically, many black laws have stripped people of their rights.
note: Refers to laws perceived as unfair or harmful to the common good in Bengali discourse.
